name: Farmer / Grower
tagline: When to plant, when to worry — from the Sun, Moon and solar wind.
action: Photoperiod windows + GPS-risk alerts for field work.
description: Day length drives flowering and hardening; solar storms degrade the GPS that steers your tractor. We turn both into one planting card.

name: Fisher
tagline: Tides and moonlight decide the catch.
description: Moon phase drives tides and feeding behavior; we rate tonight 0-100 for casting off.

name: Beekeeper
tagline: Bloom windows driven by changing daylight.
description: Colonies pace their forage to photoperiod-driven flowering; know when the flow starts.

name: Solar Owner
tagline: Your panels' best tilt and today's sun.
action: Today's solar potential + optimum tilt by season.
description: Sun elevation and day length compute your generation window; we suggest the ideal panel angle.

name: Ham Operator
tagline: Solar activity opens or kills the bands.
description: Sunspot number and solar flux predict the ionosphere; check before you key the mic.

name: Pilot / Operations
tagline: Space weather can blackout radio and degrade GPS.
action: GNSS/HF status brief for flight ops.
description: Solar flares can scramble precision approaches; a pre-flight space-weather brief keeps ops safe.

name: Astrophotographer
tagline: The Moon and satellites will ruin your frame.
description: New Moon = dark skies. Know when the ISS or a flare crosses your target.

name: Family / Dreamer
tagline: This week in the sky, explained.
description: What to look up at tonight, tomorrow, and this season — no telescope needed.

name: Student / Teacher
description: Every card links to the formula behind it, with classroom-ready explainers.

name: Hiker / Star Camper
tagline: Plan the daylight, fear the frost, time the showers.
description: Long golden hours beat midday heat, hard frosts end unprotected nights, and a meteor shower decides where (not whether) you camp.
